name: House Gudal
description: An Abzan house whose appointed leader trusts the walls.

timeline.summary: House heads squabble about trade and the waymaster's intrusion while Narset explains they are seeking a temple promised by a voice at the Crucible.
timeline.quote: we were told by a voice in the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon that there was a temple we needed to find in the dragonstorms.

pages_say.description: An Abzan house represented by a young girl while its true head is ill.
An Abzan house whose appointed leader trusts the walls.
